title: Pure Heart
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tozaki runs into Kurata, his first love from high school, and learns that Kurata knew about his feelings all along. The two fall into a physical relationship, but Kurata's feelings are complicated and stubborn, and a rival, Yoshioka, and family pressures complicate things further. A three-volume adult boys' love drama.
life_message: A first love can be rebuilt as adults only when both people face their real feelings.
